messages:
nina: Heads-up: I'm assembling a short "how-to" for migrating from v1 -> v2 with focus on model endpoint name changes and SDK shims. Need quick decisions: header name, redirect type for POSTs, and a tiny set of code snippets per SDK. Draft here: https://redwood.dev/r/4890

ben: For redirects: POST should be 307 so clients don't silently switch to GET. GETs can be 301. Also include a deprecation header, maybe `X-Redwood-Deprecation: v1`.

rahul: +1 for 307 on POST. For SDK shim: let's have compat mode log a single warning and translate string-only `model` args into the new object form when safe. Document edge cases where we can't translate.

infra-bot: Staging redirect rules applied to /v1/* -> /v2/* (preserve method/query). Tests running.

nina: Proposed minimal TS snippet for docs:
```ts
// preferred
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new Redwood({ apiVersion: 'v2' });
await c.models.create({ name: 'shopper' });

// temporary compat shim
const c2 = new Redwood({ compat: true });
await c2.models.create('shopper'); // shim maps to {name: 'shopper'} and logs warning
```
Add note: compat will be supported for ~90 days and emits telemetry.

ben: Add a curl example showing deprecation header and Location for the migration guide:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models -d '{"name":"x"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 307 Temporary Redirect
#    Location: /v2/models
#    X-Redwood-Deprecation: v1
```
Also add a short paragraph explaining client behavior: follow redirect and re-POST when necessary.

rahul: I'll add python+go snippets and a small test for shim translation. Which model names should we map by default? Suggest `redwood-base-v1` -> `redwood-base-v2-compat` and `redwood-lite-v1` -> `redwood-lite-v2-compat`. Document that these are temporary and subject to change.

infra-bot: Redirect tests green in staging. One failing case: querystring order changed; patch submitted to keep original ordering.

nina: owners: @ben header + curl example, @rahul SDK examples + tests, infra to finalize redirect behavior. I'll open a short banner PR to link to the migration doc and schedule a 10min sign-off tomorrow 11am PT.

docs-bot: Migration doc PR #4890 created by @nina in docs-staging.

ben: I'll grep docs/ and quickstarts for hard `/v1/models` links and add redirects or update examples. Found 5 spots.

rahul: pushed test fix; CI green. Added note in the guide about incompatibilities (webhook signatures, structured outputs).

nina: thanks all. Please leave lightweight reviews on PR so we can lock copy and push the banner by EOD.
